# Neuvision

> AI TVC, film and UGC that gets tested before it scales.

Neuvision generates AI TVC, film, and UGC in variants, tests them against real audiences, and scales the one that wins. The method is three stages: generate wide, test hard, scale narrow.

## Key facts

- Neuvision generates a batch of creative variants from one brief, tests them against real audience signal, and scales only the winner.
- The method has three stages: generate wide, test hard, scale narrow.
- In a batch of a dozen or two dozen variants, most perform normally or fail outright, which is the process working correctly.
- AI production replaces the physical production layer (camera, crew, location, shoot day), not the creative layer (idea, brief, edit, judgement).
